test.create_query: CREATE TABLE definer_view_read_in_order (k String, ts DateTime, v String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (k, ts)

CREATE VIEW definer_view_read_in_order_v DEFINER = CURRENT_USER SQL SECURITY DEFINER AS SELECT k, ts, v FROM definer_view_read_in_order WHERE k = 'a' UNION ALL SELECT k, ts, v FROM definer_view_read_in_order WHERE k = 'b' AND v = 'z'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO definer_view_read_in_order SELECT 'a', toDateTime(1000000000 + number), 'x' FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO definer_view_read_in_order SELECT 'b', toDateTime(1000000000 + number), if(number % 2 = 0, 'z', 'y') FROM numbers(1000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM definer_view_read_in_order_v ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 15 FORMAT Null
